name: merge_round3_gold
description: Merge the round-3 review (ko_sme_round3_sample: 120 rated rows, 72 corrections) into the adjudicated gold set with supersession. Recency wins: a round-3 row replaces any older gold row for the same concept, and older gold rows whose text violates the current rule file (warnings included — the round-3 rules encode her newest rulings) are withheld to the superseded output, which IS the confirmation list for the next reviewer email. Round-3 rows are never rule-checked away (their contradictions with older rulings, e.g. the arthrogram 조영상, go to the adjudication ledger). Promotes ko_sme_adjudicated_v2 — the object every SME lock and reviewer overlay should read from now on — plus ko_sme_superseded_r3 for the email. The original sme_gold_all.csv is untouched.
